newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela CANTV screen trade begins Dec 2 - source.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela CANTV screen trade begins Dec 2 - source.

text.p: Screen trading of shares from the global offering of Venezuelan telephone company CANTV will begin Monday December 2, according to capital markets sources, after the offer book is closed and priced on November 22.

"We estimate a share price of between $26-27 per American Depository Receipt (ADR)," said the source who asked not to be identified. Between nine and 10 local shares are expected to equal one ADR, he added.
"However the prospectus has to be approved first by Venezuela's National Securities Commission (CNV) before the offering can go ahead," he added.
The CNV is due to consider the sale prospectus of the government's 40 percent share in the company today.

According to documents obtained by Reuters, if all goes to schedule the local CANTV roadshow will begin Monday November 28; two weeks of bookbuilding will begin the following Monday; and the book will be closed and pricing begin on Thursday November 21.
"We understand that no investor will be able to buy more than five percent of the shares," said the source.
The placement will end the following Thursday, on November 28, with screen trading beginning on Monday, after the weekend, according to the document.
A bill that reforms the Privatization Law must also pass congress before the sale can go ahead. Passage of the bill is expected on Tuesday October 29.
